people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.
translations.bsb: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty of the mightiest men of Israel.
translations.kjv: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
translations.asv: Behold, it is the litter of Solomon; Threescore mighty men are about it, Of the mighty men of Israel.
